[Active, In-Slot] Turbulence - While this mode is in slot, the user begins to run faster and faster, after three speed boost, they begin to generate black wind. This means when they run near entities, it deals Wind Damage to them.

[Active, Press] Multilayer Barrier - On use, set the player's "Barrier Points" equal to their Max HP x2.5. Damage taken under the Barrier Point threshold subtract MP from the user at a rate of 5 MP per 1 HP. Attacks above the threshold reduce the barrier points to 0 and have their damage reduced by the amount of barrier points the player has.

Can be shift activated to use on another player. This will give them "Barrier Points" equal to their max hp x0.75, and will run off their energy. Cannot be used if they already have Multilayer Barrier active.

[Active, Held] Apocalypse Howling (Requires Mastery) - The user begins to run faster and faster until they turn completely into Black Wind, meaning they deal damage to entities around them, with the damage scaling based off the user's speed. The user begins to generate a forcefield around them, giving them the protection of Fault Field while they are running. After five speed boosts, the user begins to generate a Death Storm. When the user lets go of the button, they shout out "Apocalypse" which causes all nearby entities to get hit with a Black Lightning dealing 150 Damage.

(Black Wind's Damage is always based off Attack Damage + Blocks Per Second Speed )

True Dragon Interactions

Defeating a True dragon boss will make it drop a seed, when eatting the seed it will make a new skill mode apper with the dragon's name.

When their respective Sub-Mode is used within the Inner World, it will summon the true dragon which allows you to fight it to gain Bond Points upon defeating it. When the Sub-Mode is used outside of the Inner World, you will attempt to talk to your true dragon, which will give you a chance to obtain its innate skill with a low chance.

At 100 Bond Points, you can make a Shared Name with the True Dragon, acting like a Self-Name but costs you 150,000 MP. This can give 100 bond points.

At 250 Bond Points, you can obtain their respective uniques. (Divide from Veldora. Acceleration from Velgrynd. Cessation from Velzard.)

At 500 Bond Points, You can obtain their respective ultimates. (「Veldora, Lord of Storms」 from Veldora. 「Velgrynd, Lord of Scorch」 from Velgrynd. 「Velzard, Lord of Frost」 from Velzard. 「Velgaia, Lord of Earth-Star」 from Velgaia)
